text:
emma: Heads-up — acct AC123 flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows 1,243,720 tokens on 2026-02-28 but invoice INV-20260228-AC123 has the 'Standard' line at 0 tokens / $0. Customer on Growth Pro and expects tiered charge.

sophie: looking into invoice; generated 00:04 UTC. ledger rows for that invoice show Standard subtotal 0 but there are charges elsewhere. not a simple rounding. :thinking:

emma: they hit a usage burst ~23:58-00:03 UTC. customer asked for root cause and interim credit.

raj: quick hypothesis — metering-aggregator windowing + dedupe interaction dropped the final window when an ingestion retry happened. I see a spike of retries at 2026-02-28T00:00:09Z in the ingestion logs.

emma: can we repro and patch? customer wants ETA.

raj: repro steps I used locally:
1) run metering-agg for account AC123 with window aligned to midnight
2) replay batch id 98765 to simulate a retry/dedupe path
3) compare raw_events -> agg_day tokens vs invoice snapshot
SQL quick-check:
```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_total FROM metering.raw_events
WHERE account_id='AC123' AND ts>='2026-02-28' AND ts<'2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1;
```
expected 1243720 tokens, agg_day currently shows 0 for that account/date.

sophie: I ran ledger.recompute --account AC123 --date 2026-02-28 in staging and recompute surfaced the missing aggregate. recompute produced the correct token count but invoices are immutable after generation, so nothing auto-updated.

marcus: ops options: 1) reissue corrected invoice (longer, audit implications) or 2) post an adjustment line on the next invoice to reflect the missing usage. recommend adjustment for speed. need approvals from finance.

sophie: I'll prepare an adjustment line: description 'Feb 28 usage correction (metering recompute)'. tokens 1,243,720 -> charge calc in progress. assign to BILL-9843.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-9843 for invoice adjustment (acct AC123) and assigned to sophie.

emma: Please add provisional credit note for the customer until adjustment posts. I'll update them this afternoon. :thumbsup:

raj: follow-up: pushed a fix to metering-agg dedupe logic to avoid dropping final windows when retries arrive within the cutoff buffer. will canary tonight for several high-volume accounts.

marcus: ops will schedule a controlled recompute/backfill for ~200 accounts that had spikes in the midnight window. target run: 02:00 UTC off-peak, with a rollback plan and alerting.

emma: thanks — I'll keep the customer updated and close once adjustment posts. cc finance for approval. :eyes:
